impact_assessment.why: Reduced motion freezes the render timestamp to 0, but the player and monster hit flashes compare against performance.now() stamps; the age is negative forever, so the player stays red and the monster veil never clears after the first hit
impact_assessment.benefits: Hit flashes expire on their real 160/140ms schedule in reduced-motion mode; ambient bobbing, pulsing and flicker stay frozen; normal mode is unchanged
impact_assessment.risks: contract: two flash expiry checks only; dependency: none; concurrency: none; state: no save/RNG change; UI: renderer.js in the game-ui surface
impact_assessment.mitigation: Failing-first reduced-motion pixel selftest with an expired flash; source drift test; same-state 1920x1080 before/after player-tile crops; real hit under reduced motion; three-viewport inspector and full gates
